news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price gain to ₹12.72, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 9.8x. Average trailing P/E is 30x in the Auto Components industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 69% over the past three years.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.2% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Market cap is less than US$10m (₹200.7m market cap, or US$2.13m). Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (8.2% average weekly change). Profit margins are more than 30%

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.12 (vs ₹0.06 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.12 (up from ₹0.06 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹210.0m (up ₹206.4m from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹2.84m (up 80% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.4% (down from 43% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 48% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 43% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
